accuracy.why: In a test without hindsight (the last 30 days; traders chosen only on what was known before), coins that 2+ proven traders shorted together moved their way 63% of the time over the next day and did 2.3% better than the market. Following them with the fixed stop made +$14 per $100 risked (61% winners), −$4 in the first half of the period and +$21 in the second. 31 trades on 11 coins is too few to call it proven: the live record decides. Their longs did no better than the market (52% right, +0.1% against the market), so long crowds are shown as information only.
accuracy.why_short: Shorts by 2+ proven traders were right 63% of the time and +2.3% against the market over a day (31 trades, a 30-day test without hindsight): promising, too few to call proven. Their longs: no edge.
accuracy.rule: When 2 or more proven Hyperliquid traders open or add to shorts on the same coin within 24 hours (more of them than open longs), short it at the next hour: stop 1.5 typical daily moves away (at least 1.5%), out after 24 hours.
